name: Colorado
overview: The 2025 Property Tax/Rent/Heat Credit rebate supports qualifying seniors' property-tax, rent, and heat costs; disabled residents may instead qualify for the Disability Assistance Credit.

programs.name: Property Tax/Rent/Heat Credit rebate
programs.ageRule: Age 65+ or surviving spouse age 58+ for 2025 PTC.
programs.incomeDefinition: Total income from all sources under the PTC instructions.
programs.maximumBenefit: Combined property/rent/heat rebate up to $1,178; property/rent component follows its own schedule.
programs.formulaSummary: Income- and expense-based property/rent and heat rebates; combined maximum is not solely property-tax relief.
programs.application: File 2025 DR 0104PTC; applications accepted through December 31, 2027.
eligibilityNotes: Full-year Colorado residence; cannot be another taxpayer's dependent.
Alternate identification procedure is available without SSN/ITIN.
interactions: PTC and Disability Assistance Credit cannot both be claimed for the same year.

programs.name: Real estate taxes in Colorado’s income tax base
programs.ageRule: No age test applies to real estate taxes in the federal itemized deduction.
programs.incomeDefinition: Colorado starts from federal taxable income, which reflects a federal filer’s election to claim itemized deductions.
programs.incomeLimits: The federal combined tax deduction phases down at higher modified adjusted gross income. Colorado adds back some standard or itemized deductions for taxpayers at the state income threshold.
programs.maximumBenefit: The amount of qualifying real estate taxes included within the federal combined limit, subject to Colorado’s additions to federal taxable income.
programs.formulaSummary: DR 0104 starts with federal taxable income that reflects itemized real estate taxes. Colorado’s state income tax addback worksheet leaves real estate taxes within the federal deduction. Higher-income filers can also face a separate addition for excess federal deductions.
programs.application: Report qualified real estate taxes on federal Schedule A, line 5b. Enter federal taxable income on Colorado DR 0104 line 1 and follow the state income tax addback instructions for line 2.
eligibilityNotes: The calculator uses a single full-year resident, moderate wages-only income, and sufficient mortgage interest to itemize even before property taxes.
interactions: Federal law limits the combined deduction for state and local taxes. On the 2025 Colorado return, line 2 adds back state income tax within the deduction and line 4 can restore other amounts for filers at the higher-income threshold.
programs.programYear: 2025 Colorado income tax return and 2025 federal Schedule A.

sources.title: Colorado DOR state income tax addback worksheet

researchNotes: From tax year 2025, disabled residents of any age may receive the refundable DAC ($400–$1,200 by income/status); it replaces their former PTC route and is income-based rather than a housing-expense credit.
DAC federal-AGI limits: $20,000 single/$32,000 joint; full-year qualifying disability benefits required.
Senior Housing Income Tax Credit is unavailable for tax year 2025.
